roadSelection: Reuse the pre-existing area_example_design L1, not selected using these 45,000-trip results.
branchRule: At 25%, 50%, 75% of L1; alternate north/south sides. Nearest distinct retained at-grade source-road group, distance 80–500 m, perpendicular offset at least 40 m, endpoints inside ROI margin. No outcome-based tuning.
sameDemand: Generate local baseline demand once, reuse identical trip objects for all three alternatives. No induced demand.
limitations: One seed, one hypothetical alignment; not a planning recommendation.
Fixed routes based on free-flow cost and expected signal delay; no congestion rerouting.
